description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with a Supabase database, including creating a client, performing batched upsert operations, deleting all rows, counting rows, and fetching ID mappings. It is part of a backend data handling module.

methods.name: Client get_supabase_client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

methods.name: int _upsert_chunk( client: Client, table: str, rows: List[Dict], on_conflict: str, returning: str = "minimal", )
methods.description: Performs an upsert operation on a batch of rows, retrying up to three times with exponential backoff.

methods.name: int upsert_in_batches( client: Client, table: str, rows: Iterable[Dict], on_conflict: str, batch_size: int = 500, returning: str = "minimal", verbose: bool = True, )
methods.description: Upserts data rows in manageable batches, with optional verbose output, handling retries and backoff.

methods.name: int delete_all(client: Client, table: str)
methods.description: Deletes all rows from a specified table; a dangerous operation requiring service role privileges.

methods.name: Optional[int] get_count(client: Client, table: str)
methods.description: Returns the exact number of rows in a table.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] get_id_map(client: Client, table: str, key_field: str = "name", id_field: str = "id")
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping from a key field (default 'name') to IDs for a reference table, paginated to handle large datasets.

ctags.signature: ( client: Client, table: str, rows: List[Dict], on_conflict: str, returning: str = "minimal", )
